##### Project general facts

Yas Riva Reserve by Aldar is a gated waterfront village of single-row villas set along a canal, offering a more private and tranquil residential setting. Warm timber architecture, light facades, panoramic glazing, clean geometric volumes and vertical sun screens give the homes a contemporary character. Each villa rises from a ground floor to a first floor, with inland residences offering four, five and six bedrooms and waterfront villas offering five and six bedrooms, all surrounded by private gardens and green community spaces.

Amenities are designed for every age. A community clubhouse brings together an adult swimming pool, a kids' swimming pool, an indoor fitness area, a yoga studio, a library and study lounge and an indoor games room. Outdoors, residents enjoy a jogging track, a community-wide cycle track, an outdoor fitness area, padel courts, outdoor table tennis, a meditation lawn, a canal viewing deck, splash pads, a sand playground, climbing play, picnic lawns and neighbourhood and pocket parks.

Homes are planned for spacious family living, with bright, open layouts that connect living areas with private gardens and terraces. Waterfront residences overlook the canal, while pontoons on the water add a distinctive touch to life in the community. A walkable retail village with a cafe, a mini mart, a pharmacy, a salon, a barbershop, a laundry and a mosque provides everyday services close to home. Villas are delivered unfurnished, leaving furniture and decoration to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Yas Island is one of Abu Dhabi's leading leisure and lifestyle destinations, home to world-class theme parks, beaches, golf, marinas and entertainment venues. Its canal-side edge offers a quieter residential setting while keeping Yas Mall, Yas Marina, Yas Marina Circuit, Ferrari World, Yas Waterworld, Warner Bros. World and SeaWorld Yas Island within easy reach, together with beaches, restaurants and landscaped parks.

Zayed International Airport is a short drive away, and Saadiyat Island and the centre of Abu Dhabi are easily reached. Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed Highway and Abu Dhabi–Dubai Highway connect residents with the capital and Dubai, while international schools, clinics and supermarkets serve families across the island and neighbouring districts, making daily life convenient for residents of all ages and keeping the wider capital close at hand.

Yas Island is an investment zone open to international buyers and one of the most popular family destinations in Abu Dhabi. Gated waterfront villa communities with canal frontage are in limited supply on the island, supporting strong demand from families and end users. A mature leisure offer and the backing of a leading developer underpin long-term value and resilient resale prospects.
